title: Merge Nodes in Between Zeros
goal: Merge each run between zero delimiters into one sum node.
strategy: Walk the actual list while accumulating positive values. An ending zero commits the run sum to a new output node and resets the accumulator for the next run.

edgeCases: One positive value between delimiters remains its own sum
